reconciliation.problem_name: Khare control with unweighted stoichiometric reconciliation

$comment: Khare 2026 control/SOM coefficients k1-k45 from supplement Table 6, network Table 2, initial means Table 11, feeds Table 12. Rates nmol/(million cells day); affinities mM. Growth basis 2310 nmol pseudo-biomass/million cells and product pseudo-MW 126 g/mol from Nolan thesis pp49-50; not whole antibody MW. R35 bare Km35 interpreted as Km35a following Cui 2024 Box I. Death k45 is source dimensionless: assume a fixed 0.25-day reference interval (not solver step), yielding 0.0012/day. No fitted multipliers. Numerical reaction caps +/-1e6 are not biological capacities. Unweighted reconciliation matches the SOM flux objective; native integration and inventory constraints remain. Initial dead cells/IVCD zero. CYSTINE feed 85 mM is an explicit interpretation of ambiguous Cysteine/Cystine entry; missing modeled feed constituents assumed zero. Absolute feed volumes implement the baseline current-volume percentages (7A then 7B based on pre-addition volume); changing kinetics may require recalculating those volumes. Glucose targets 39/47 mM are approximate graph readings. End day7 before feeding; withdrawals and evaporation neglected. See ../README.md.
